Zahn: the original melody lies in the tenor; the discant melody was later often used as main melody, with or without the tenor. M. Prätorius has a five-voice setting with the discant melody and the tenor melody an octave higher as Quinta vox ('wird an etlichen Orten statt der Choralstimme gebraucht'). Lossius 1579, Eler 1588, Gesius 1601. 21, Schott 1603 set discant melody in discant and tenor melody in tenor; Crüger 1640 has Triller's tenor in the discant and his discant in the tenor.
